description: Summarize the power grid around a Texas address or coordinate, including the high and low side voltage and OpenStreetMap class (transmission or distribution) of the 3 nearest substations: county, the likely serving utility, the 3 nearest substations with distance, transmission lines nearby, ERCOT generation queue projects nearby, and planned transmission upgrades within 25 miles, and railroads: the nearest rail lines with owner and type, and whether a railroad lies between the site and its nearest substation (or a point you pass as to_lat/to_lng). Use when someone asks what power infrastructure is near a site, whether a property could host a data center, battery or large load, or who the utility is.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles for lines and queue projects. Default 5, max 25.

to_lat.description: Optional second point (e.g. a planned substation pad or a named POI) to test rail crossings against, instead of the nearest substation.

to_lng.description: Longitude of the optional second point.

name: grid_context
title: Grid context for a Texas site
